items.title: Special termination right (price increase)
items.quote: Sie dürfen den Vertrag deshalb innerhalb von drei Monaten nach Erhalt dieses Schreibens kostenlos und ohne Kündigungsfrist beenden, frühestens zum Wirksamwerden der Preisänderung.
items.computation: The letter is dated Wed 18.11.2026 and is a company letter, so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies; the actual day of receipt is not stated, so the earliest plausible start is the letter's own date, 18.11.2026. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of receipt itself is not counted, so the three-month period begins 19.11.2026. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a period of months ends with the day of the last month that bears the same number as the start day, i.e. 18.02.2027 (a Thursday, no weekend/holiday shift needed). The cancellation may only take effect at the earliest on 01.02.2027 (when the new price applies), but the declaration itself must reach the provider by 18.02.2027. If the letter actually arrived later than 18.11.2026, the three-month deadline would move back by the same number of days.

warnings: The exact day this letter was received by the customer is not stated, so the 18.02.2027 deadline is the earliest plausible date; if the letter arrived after 18.11.2026 the three-month window to cancel ends correspondingly later.

The special termination right only takes effect at the earliest on 01.02.2027 (when the price increase becomes effective), so an early cancellation would not end the contract before that date even if declared sooner.
